sloka: सीता तु परमायत्ता दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणमातुरम् ।उवाच वाक्यं धर्मज्ञा किमिदं रुद्यते त्वया ।। ७.४६.२५ ॥
transliteration: sītā tu paramāyattā dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇamāturam ।uvāca vākyaṁ dharmajñā kimidaṁ rudyate tvayā ।। 7.46.25 ॥

translations.english: But Sita, a knower of dharma and greatly agitated upon seeing Lakshmana distressed, asked him, "Why are you weeping like this?"
